intro.h2: Cabinets and countertops, supplied and installed
paragraphs: Cabinet & Countertop Solutions sells cabinets and countertops in Rockingham, NC, from a kitchen supply store you can visit on US-1. Stop by during opening hours to talk through your kitchen or bathroom, or call ahead and we can schedule a time.

Then the same company handles the install. One homeowner told us her quartz countertop and backsplash job with Carolyn and the install team was seamless from start to finish. Another ordered two different countertops and says they are just what she asked for. Our photos show white quartz kitchens, copper and stainless sinks, and long bathroom vanity tops.

services.h2: What you can get from our Rockingham store

items.name: Quartz countertops
items.blurb: White quartz with soft gray or gold veining shows up again and again in our installs, cut for L-shaped runs, large islands and undermount sinks in stainless or hammered copper. Quartz countertops are one of the topics customers mention most in our Google reviews.

image.alt: L-shaped kitchen with white quartz countertops, white wall cabinets and gray base cabinets

items.name: Kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Kitchen cabinets to go with your new counters, from white raised-panel kitchens with dark hardware to tall pantry units over gray base cabinets. Choose the style and finish with us, and ask about installation when you order your countertops.

image.alt: White raised-panel kitchen cabinets with a copper range hood, wall ovens and a marble mosaic backsplash

items.name: Backsplash and tile
items.blurb: Backsplash finishes the countertop job, and backsplash installs come up in several of our reviews. Kitchens in our photos have marble mosaic tile behind a copper range hood and a full quartz splash behind the sink and cooktop.

image.alt: White kitchen with a quartz island, black refrigerator and mosaic tile backsplash under a pendant light

items.name: Bathroom vanity tops
items.blurb: Quartz is not only for kitchens. One client ordered two different countertops for her bathrooms and says they are just what she asked for. Our photos include a long double vanity with two undermount sinks and a quartz top with a matching splash.

image.alt: Long bathroom vanity with a white quartz top, two undermount sinks and light wood drawers

items.name: Flooring
items.blurb: Plank flooring in gray and natural oak looks appears in our own photos alongside slabs and cabinets, so ask about matching a new floor to your cabinets and counters. Call or stop by the store to see what is available for your kitchen or bath.

image.alt: Blue-gray stone slab, two wood-look flooring planks and wrapped white shaker cabinets under the Cabinet & Countertop Solutions name

items.name: Kitchen and bath remodels
items.blurb: For bigger jobs, the work goes past the counters. One customer says that if you are looking for help with your remodeling needs, this is the company to help. Call to talk through a kitchen or bathroom update, from cabinets and tops to backsplash.

image.alt: Two men standing in a finished white kitchen with a copper range hood and a white quartz island

about.text: Cabinet & Countertop Solutions LLC runs a kitchen supply store at 899 US-1 in Rockingham, under the black and gold C&C sign. We sell cabinets and countertops, and our install team puts in countertops, backsplash and bathroom vanity tops. Customers deal with real people: reviewers mention Carolyn by name, along with the install team that comes to your house. All of our Google reviews are five stars so far, from a pair of bathroom tops to a full kitchen with a copper range hood, marble backsplash and a big quartz island.

image.alt: Black and gold C&C Cabinet & Countertop Solutions LLC sign with the phone number outside the Rockingham store

steps.title: Give us a call
steps.text: Call (910) 474-1447 or email candcllc0125@gmail.com, and we can schedule a time that works for you.

steps.title: Choose your materials
steps.text: Visit the store at 899 US-1 to go over quartz, cabinets and backsplash options with our team.

steps.title: Measure and order
steps.text: We measure your kitchen or bathroom so the cabinets and countertops are ordered and cut to fit your actual space.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Our install team sets the countertops, sink and backsplash, as reviewers describe in their kitchen and bathroom jobs.

steps.title: Enjoy the result
steps.text: We check the finished install with you so the countertops and cabinets are exactly what you asked for before the team leaves.

service_area.h2: Cabinets and countertops in Rockingham, NC
service_area.text: Our store is at 899 US-1 in Rockingham, NC 28379, and Rockingham is the town listed for our work. If you live outside town and want to know whether we can measure and install at your place, call (910) 474-1447 and ask. You are also welcome to stop by during opening hours, Monday to Saturday, to talk through your project.

items.q: Where is your store and when is it open?
items.a: We are at 899 US-1, Rockingham, NC 28379. The store is open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM. We are closed on Sunday. Look for the black and gold C&C sign out front.

items.q: Do you install, or only sell materials?
items.a: Both. Customers buy countertops from us and our install team puts them in, along with sinks and backsplash. Reviewers praise the install team and say the finished countertops are just what they asked for. Call to talk through what your kitchen or bathroom needs, including cabinets.

Countertops, cabinets and backsplash, with flooring samples also shown in our photos. Our recent jobs use white quartz with gray or gold veining, and our photos show a blue-gray stone slab, gray and oak-look flooring planks and white shaker cabinets. Call to ask about a specific color.

items.q: Do you work on bathrooms too?
items.a: Yes. We cut and install quartz vanity tops, including long double vanities with undermount sinks and matching splash. One customer ordered two different countertops for her home and says they came out just as she asked. Ask about larger kitchen and bathroom updates when you call.

Call (910) 474-1447 or email candcllc0125@gmail.com, and we can schedule a time to talk about your kitchen or bathroom. You are also welcome to stop by the store on US-1 during opening hours, Monday to Saturday, to talk through your project in person.
